name: Pacific Northwest Tree Magnets - 6 painted multi-colour fridge magnets
description:
Six Pacific Northwest trees as fridge magnets: Douglas Fir, Western Red Cedar, Sitka Spruce, Western Hemlock, Pacific Madrone, Bigleaf Maple. Each one is the front half of a stylised tree, about 75 mm tall, with a flat back and hidden magnet pockets, so it sits flat on the fridge.

Every tree comes as a painted 3MF for 4-filament printers (Bambu AMS, Snapmaker U1) and as a plain STL for single-colour printing. All six use the same four filaments in the same slots, so you load the printer once and can mix trees on one plate.

Included:
- Douglas Fir, 39 x 75 mm, 21 mm deep, 3 x 6x3 mm magnets
- Western Red Cedar, 60 x 75 mm, 24 mm deep, 3 x 6x3 mm magnets
- Sitka Spruce, 27 x 75 mm, 14 mm deep, 3 x 5x2 mm magnets
- Western Hemlock, 46 x 75 mm, 20 mm deep, 1 x 6x3 mm magnets
- Pacific Madrone, 65 x 75 mm, 23 mm deep, 2 x 6x3 mm magnets
- Bigleaf Maple, 69 x 73 mm, 23 mm deep, 3 x 6x3 mm magnets

Magnets to buy: 12 x 6x3 mm and 3 x 5x2 mm neodymium discs. Each pocket gets a thin printed lid, so the magnets are hidden.

Filaments: Dark forest green, Moss green, Dark brown, Golden amber. Matte PLA suits them.

Print flat back down with 0.12 mm layers; few supports needed. A print guide is in the zip.

The trees were generated with Hi3D, then cut flat, fitted with magnet pockets and painted for multi-colour printing.
